title: Minimum Deletions for At Most K Distinct Characters
summary: Given a string of lowercase English letters and an integer k, remove the minimum number of characters to ensure the remaining string has at most k distinct characters.
statement: Given a string of lowercase English letters and an integer k, remove the minimum number of characters to ensure the remaining string has at most k distinct characters.
constraints: Delete characters so at most k distinct letters remain.
Return the minimum number of deleted character occurrences.
You may choose which letter groups to remove.
hints: If too many groups exist, entire letter groups must be removed.
Delete the smallest frequencies until only k groups remain.
This exchange-optimal choice minimizes removed characters.
editorial: This exchange-optimal choice minimizes removed characters.

tests.explanation: Deleting any one character leaves two distinct letters, costing one.
Delete one two-character group, costing two.
